cand.title: Expo Nacional Ferretera 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Priority contact: Grecia Magdaleno Damken, named official travel-agency contact on the 2027 event page; relevant to hotel-programme access and reservations. RX escalation: Javier García, listed Event Director, relevant for identifying the accommodation/commercial decision owner. Ariadna Rivero is the named exhibitor Customer Experience contact and can route exhibitor-service questions. No source establishes that any of these people personally signs hotel contracts.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed organizer-announced activity dates: 9–11 September 2027 at Expo Guadalajara, within the requested horizon. The homepage header/footer and dedicated official travel-agency page agree. The homepage also retains 3–5 September 2026 material; those dates are historical, not the next edition. No 2028 Guadalajara dates established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong city/convention-hotel fit rather than a destination-resort brief. The show brings hardware-sector exhibitors and buyers to Expo Guadalajara; Marriott places Sheraton Guadalajara Expo minutes from the venue and advertises meeting spaces, catering and event-planning assistance. Using the supplied 216-room inventory, pursue selected exhibitor teams, buyers and small ancillary gatherings, not a claim to house the whole exhibition. More than 25,000 specialized visitors is a published 2025 historical result, not a 2027 hotel-room forecast.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the publicly announced 2027 exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. This establishes an announced venue commitment, not access to a signed venue contract. No 2027 headquarters hotel, contracted accommodation roster or guaranteed room allotment was verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified flagship timeline: 7–9 September 2023, 5–7 September 2024, 4–6 September 2025 and 3–5 September 2026, all at Expo Guadalajara. No destination or venue rotation is demonstrated across those editions. The CDMX programme is a separate expansion, not evidence that Guadalajara rotates to Mexico City.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, not open and not demonstrably closed. The current 2027 official agency page names Grecia Magdaleno Damken. An official 2026 event post identified Corporativo ODE as exclusive travel agency; ODE publishes nearby-hotel special rates and booking codes with a 2026 tariff image. These prove a historical accommodation distribution pathway, not 2027 supplier onboarding or a guaranteed block. ODE continuity for 2027 requires confirmation. Independent exhibitor-team contracting is a proposed secondary route, not a verified open procurement process.
findings.organizationStructure: The organizer is RX, a commercial exhibition organizer, not an association. Expo Nacional Ferretera is the hardware/electrical/construction-industry trade show; the supplied sports_entertainment segment is not supported. Expo Guadalajara is the venue. Corporativo ODE is the documented 2026 exclusive travel intermediary, not the event owner; its 2027 mandate is unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The exhibition itself is committed to Expo Guadalajara; do not pitch relocation of its main exhibition to hotel meeting rooms. The 2026 agency pathway creates an intermediary relationship to qualify, but does not establish a 2027 closed hotel programme. GH Collection advertised event-specific 2026 rates for Hotel Las Pérgolas, Hotel Olá Chapultepec and Hotel Aló Degollado; Hotel Ejecutivo Express also marketed 2026 stays. These are historical competitor offers, not verified official host hotels, occupied blocks or overflow evidence. No sourced sold-out/overflow requirement was established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Grecia first through the 2027 page (WhatsApp 33 1353 9815; telephone 33 4711 2676). Ask which entity manages 2027 accommodation, who selects hotels, whether the roster is still accepting proposals, and for the official hotel list, required nights, allotments, terms and historical pickup. With permission, submit Sheraton’s proximity, guestrooms and small-meeting proposition; do not promise inventory before checking hotel availability. Escalate routing to Javier García, copying Ariadna Rivero for exhibitor-service coordination if appropriate. If closed, ask about permitted independent exhibitor bookings and next-cycle review; do not presume overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026, the 2026 edition has passed; the next verified Guadalajara edition is September 2027. Organizer and agency contact channels are public, so relationship access exists. Hotel procurement access remains unconfirmed: no open RFP, supplier invitation, available allotment or 2027 booking roster was verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: 2027 capture should focus on official hotel-programme inclusion if supplier selection remains accessible, plus exhibitor/company teams and off-site meetings. Historical continuity supports recurring relationship development, but does not prove open future cycles. Seek next-cycle consideration if the 2027 roster is closed. Do not represent September 2028 as a confirmed event.
